page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc8i.32xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized virtual server from the high-clock-speed hfc8i family, deployed on the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 6462C processors running at a base clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The configuration allocates 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a compute-dense 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per core. The instance operates without discrete hardware GPU acceleration.

Network infrastructure on the instance provides a high-throughput baseline bandwidth of 100 Gbps, enabling rapid inter-node communication and efficient distributed scaling. The instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions for all persistent operating system and data requirements. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned directly to the instance.

Cost efficiency is centered around dense CPU resource allocation and elevated clock rates, allowing compute-bound tasks to execute across 128 dedicated threads without incurring the overhead of excess memory capacity. Workloads well-suited for ecs.hfc8i.32xlarge include large-scale batch processing, scientific simulations, distributed compilation, electronic design automation (EDA), financial modeling, and high-throughput network-dependent computational clusters.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc8i.32xlarge is a high-clock-speed compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor at 3.3 GHz. Configured with 128 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs and 256.0 GB of RAM, it maintains a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio yielding 2.0 GB per core. The server includes no local storage volumes and contains no GPU accelerators, routing persistent storage through external block storage. Network performance is anchored by a 100 Gbps baseline bandwidth, facilitating high-speed data exchanges across distributed computing topologies. The platform provides strong resource density and compute-per-thread efficiency for parallel, processor-intensive operations. It is well suited for high-performance computing, large-scale software builds, financial quantitative simulations, and compute-bound batch analytics.
